---
title: "COVID-19 in Europa"
author: "Rachel van der Kreeft"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    code_folding: hide
params:
  country: "Netherlands"
  year: [2021, 2022]
  months: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r libraries, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

```


```{r importeer dataset, message=FALSE}

# Importeer dataset met gegevens over het dagelijkse aantal nieuwe gemelde COVID-19-gevallen en sterfgevallen per EU/EER-land.
covid <- read_csv("~/dsfb2/dsfb2_workflows_portfolio/dsfb2_workflows_portfolio/projecten/8_geparametrizeerde_rmarkdown/data.csv")

```


```{r filteren van de parameters}

# Filter de data op de parameters
covid_filtered <- covid %>%
  filter(
    countriesAndTerritories == params$country,
    year %in% params$year,
    month %in% params$months
  )

```

## Grafiek 1: COVID-19 gevallen

```{r covid-19 gevallen}

# groepeer op year en month en vervang maandcijfers door namen van de maanden
covid_cases_monthly <- covid_filtered %>%
  group_by(year, month) %>%
  summarise(cases = sum(cases, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(month = factor(month, levels = 1:12, labels = month.abb))

# maak een grafiek voor aantal covid-19 gevallen
ggplot(covid_cases_monthly, aes(x = month, y = cases)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~year) +
  labs(
    title = paste("COVID-19 cases in", params$country),
    x = "Month",
    y = "Number of cases"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

```


## Grafiek 2: COVID-19 sterfgevallen

```{r covid-19 sterfgevallen}

# groepeer op year en month en vervang maandcijfers door namen van de maanden
covid_deaths_monthly <- covid_filtered %>%
  group_by(year, month) %>%
  summarise(deaths = sum(deaths, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(month = factor(month, levels = 1:12, labels = month.abb))

# maak een grafiek voor aantal mensen die zijn overleden aan covid-19 
ggplot(covid_deaths_monthly, aes(x = month, y = deaths)) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick", width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~year) +
  labs(
    title = paste("COVID-19 deaths in", params$country),
    x = "Month",
    y = "Number of deaths"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

```
